product_overview: eSkill SEO Optimizer is an authenticated operations dashboard for Mercado Livre sellers. It provides access to core workspace modules for financial reporting, live Pregão monitoring, pricing intelligence, catalog cloning search, and account health diagnostics.
core_goals: Log in with email and password to access the authenticated dashboard shell.
View the main dashboard overview and navigate to operational modules.
Open the Financials dashboard and review PnL and summary information.
Open the Pregão live panel and inspect the live monitoring interface.
Open the Pricing dashboard and review suggested pricing information.
Open the Catalog Clone search page and search for catalog items.
Open the Account Health page and review diagnostic summaries.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows a user to authenticate with email and password and enter the protected dashboard area.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in invalid email or password -> Submit the login form -> See a validation or authentication error

features.name: Main Dashboard
features.description: Provides the authenticated dashboard shell with key metrics and navigation to the product modules.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View dashboard metrics cards -> Use the navigation to move to other modules

features.name: Financials Dashboard
features.description: Shows financial reporting content such as PnL, balance, settlements, and summary widgets.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/financials -> View PnL and summary widgets -> Review the financial reporting overview
Navigate to /dashboard/financials -> Change the date filter -> View updated financial summary information

features.name: Pregao Live Panel
features.description: Displays a read-oriented live operations panel for Pregão with events and charts.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/pregao -> Observe the live event feed and charts -> Review the current Pregão status

features.name: Pricing Dashboard
features.description: Shows dynamic pricing intelligence, including suggested prices and alerts.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/pricing -> Inspect suggested prices and alerts -> Review the pricing intelligence dashboard

features.name: Catalog Clone Search
features.description: Lets a user search for catalog listings to review cloning-related results.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/catalog/clonar-anuncios -> Enter a search query -> Review the search results list

features.name: Account Health
features.description: Shows diagnostic information about Mercado Livre account health and related pillars.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/account-health -> View the diagnostic summary -> Review the account health pillars

routes.description: Login com email e senha da sessão do dashboard
